messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: P1 pager: Significant GPU capacity exhaustion detected in us-west-2 cluster 'infer-prod-1'. Queue depth 1,260 (target <200). Autoscaler attempted scale but nodes stuck in Pending due to LaunchTemplate/InstanceProfile attach error. Impact: increased 503s and token throttles for realtime endpoints. Escalating to on-call. https://incidents.redwood.example/INC-2026-0423/

Alice (oncall): ack I'm on it, checking cluster state now.

Carlos (sre): I'm here. First glance: autoscaler logs show "AttachInstanceProfile: AccessDenied" for the new nodes, repeated 6x. Could be IMDS/passrole policy regression.

Emma (infra): I see a recent LaunchTemplate revision rolled 40m ago with a different instance profile ARN. Rolling back that LT might fix it.

Maya (support): Customer impact: three customers report degraded inference latency >2s and intermittent 500s. Notifying priority customers.

Alice (oncall): Runbook step 1: gather kubectl describe nodes/events + autoscaler logs. Running: `kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=inference-queue -o wide`

DeployBot: new deployment 2026-04-23T01:12 by emma: launch-template=v5 -> v6 (instanceProfile=arn:aws:iam::111:instance-profile/rt-attach-2026)

Carlos (sre): Paste of recent controller logs: ```
I0423 01:40:22 autoscaler.go:213] scale up request for 8 GPUs
E0423 01:40:25 aws_manager.go:112] AttachInstanceProfile failed: AccessDenied: User: arn:aws:sts::111:assumed-role/cluster-controller/... is not authorized to perform: iam:PassRole on resource: arn:aws:iam::111:role/rt-node-role
E0423 01:40:25 autoscaler.go:241] unable to provision nodegroup: attach role denied
```

Emma (infra): That error aligns with a permissions change in the IAM policy applied 45m ago. I'm checking CloudTrail.

Dave (product): Quick check — can we switch affected routes to a smaller model variant for soft-fail to reduce GPU demand while we fix infra?

Alice (oncall): Good idea. I'll flip model routing to fallback-small for the top-traffic endpoints via the console feature flag. Doing now: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood/.../route-fallback -d '{...}'`

Maya (support): Thanks, Alice. I told 2 priority customers we've routed to a lower-capacity fallback and are mitigating.

Emma (infra): CloudTrail shows a recent change: iam:PassRole permission removed from the cluster's controller role by a cross-account cleanup job. Reverting ACL should be quick. However org change process might take 20-30m.

Carlos (sre): While infra works on IAM, we should manually increase worker ASG desired capacity to drain queue faster using instance types that don't need the new attach flow. Proposal: spin up an existing nodegroup with LT v4 (known-good) and taint it gpu=true:NoSchedule removed to allow scheduling.

Emma (infra): I can force-create nodes by updating ASG desired count + attach launch-config v4. Executing: `aws autoscaling set-desired-capacity --auto-scaling-group-name infer-gpu-asg-v4 --desired-capacity 8 --honor-cooldown`

Alice (oncall): Noted — I'm cordoning a few stale nodes to move workload: `kubectl cordon ip-10-0-12-34` and adding tolerations for fallback pods.

DeployBot: ASG update accepted, launching 8 instances. Instance IDs: i-0abc, i-0def ... (pending).

Carlos (sre): Rebalancer indicates pods are starting to schedule on the new instances, but some jobs still stuck in queue due to concurrency limits in the inference worker config. Increasing worker concurrency by 2x for short window.

Alice (oncall): Patching deployment: `kubectl -n prod patch deploy inference-worker -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"worker","env":[{"name":"MAX_CONCURRENCY","value":"40"}]}]}}}}'`

Maya (support): Customer update sent — they appreciate the quick mitigation, asking for ETA. I told them ~30-45m for measurable improvement.

Emma (infra): IAM rollback approved by infra-admin. Reapplying iam:PassRole to controller role now. `terraform apply` in progress.

Carlos (sre): Autoscaler log tail after IAM fix: ```
I0423 02:05:11 aws_manager.go:112] AttachInstanceProfile succeeded for nodegroup infer-gpu
I0423 02:05:13 autoscaler.go:326] created 6 new nodes for GPU pool
```

Alice (oncall): Nodes are now Ready, and queue depth is dropping: was 1,260 -> 410 in 15m. Latency for fallback routes stable ~800ms.

Maya (support): Another customer reported reduced errors, thanks. Continued monitoring requested.

Dave (product): Good catch. After stabilizing, we should schedule a post-incident to evaluate why the IAM cleanup ran without the safety gate. Also consider feature to auto-fallback model routes when GPU queue > threshold.

Emma (infra): Agreed. I'll open a ticket to add a pre-deploy check that verifies iam:PassRole presence for any launchtemplate changes.

Carlos (sre): Action items: 1) Postmortem draft (Alice/Carlos) 2) IAM guardrails (Emma) 3) Autoscaler healthcheck to detect attach failures and trigger alternate ASG (Carlos) 4) Product route fallback as an automated mitigation (Dave).

Alice (oncall): Marking incident as mitigated at 1762511276 (queue <400 and autoscaler healthy). I'll start the postmortem doc and link customers.

IncidentBot: Incident INC-2026-0423 status -> mitigated. Timeline saved.

Maya (support): I'll follow up with all impacted customers with the mitigation summary and ETA for permanent fix.

Alice (oncall): Thanks team. I'll keep the CHANNEL open for any aftershock reports. :thumbsup:
